foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat $100.00 filing fee for the Foreign Registration Statement, available online through Fast Track Filing or by paper.
foreignQualification.filedWith: Iowa Secretary of State, Business Services Division
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File the biennial report in odd-numbered years, due April 1 ($30.00 online / $45.00 paper), and maintain a registered agent in Iowa.

evidence.quote: Businesses, both domestic and foreign, will file a biennial report with the Office of the Iowa Secretary of State every other year.
The fee is $30* by online filing or $45* by paper.
SECRETARY OF STATE Business Services Division

notes: The Foreign Registration Statement fee is $100 on the common filing path; the page marks the form as available online through Fast Track Filing. The biennial report applies to both domestic and foreign businesses (odd-numbered years, due April 1; $30 online / $45 paper, matching root states.json's $30 figure).
